overview: The Medford Energy and Environment Committee reviewed preparations for the upcoming Harvest Your Energy Festival, received administrative and policy updates on municipal sustainability projects, and heard an educational presentation on PFAS chemicals.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Next Meeting Date
items.summary: Approved the previous meeting's minutes as edited and scheduled the next meeting for November 13, 2024.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff announced the hiring of head clerk Jackie Furtado and reported that the City Hall elevator is back in service.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Logistics
items.summary: Staff and committee members reviewed event logistics for the October 19 festival at the McGlynn Middle School, including volunteer shifts, parking restrictions, an electric vehicle showcase, a new free shuttle bus service, and on-site shredding and electronics recycling.

items.title: Policy and Sustainability Initiatives Update
items.summary: Staff provided updates on the 99-year lease RFP for Medford Square redevelopment parcels, the Electrify Medford coaching initiative, citywide composting program expansion, and net-zero design planning for the new fire station and school HVAC projects.

items.title: Waste Reduction Update
items.summary: Robert Paine shared that he distributed an introductory email on 21 waste reduction steps and will present further next month.

items.title: PFAS Educational Presentation
items.summary: A committee member delivered a detailed presentation on PFAS chemistry, commercial and consumer uses, health and environmental hazards, and emerging remediation methods.

items.title: New Business
items.summary: Robert Paine requested a future agenda item on Medford's flood vulnerability and municipal mitigation plans following recent severe hurricane flooding elsewhere.
